description: This Java class defines a main application that sets up and runs an embedded Jetty server for deploying a web application. It configures the server, network connector, and web context, and manages shutdown hooks.

classes.name: EnterpriseApplication
classes.description: Main class that configures and manages an embedded Jetty server for a web application.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the application that initializes the server, configures connectors and web context, and manages shutdown hooks.

methods.description: Resolves a resource URL from classpath given a resource name.

methods.description: Determines port number from system property or defaults to 8090.
